title: TABLE 65 FATE - the twelve fate bands of the 1d20 roll with their face widths
audit_comment: OA round fifty-five (capture p. 135): Table 65 - the fate table of the fourth level fate spell, the twelve 1d20 bands with their face widths, cross-checked between the passes

banner.title: TABLE 65 FATE, printed capture p. 135 - the OA fate round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read (print p. 135; compressed p. 66); the twelve band rows cross-checked line by line between the passes, zero contested reads - the outcome prose agrees verbatim. The table answers the fourth level fate spell, rolled when the DM knows of no particular event that will occur to the character. The outcomes are DM-adventure seeds - general statements whose value is narrative, so the cells pin the band STRUCTURE, not the prose: the bands pin as a chain (the 1d20 roll mapped to its band: rolls 1, 2, 3 the single-face bands, 4-5, 6-7, 8-9 and 16-17 the two-face pairs, 10-12 and 13-15 the three-face widest bands at the ladder middle, 18, 19 and 20 the single-face tail) and a one-column grid of the band face widths - six single-face, four two-face and two three-face bands summing to the twenty faces of the die. The one-fate-at-a-time rule pins as the didT65FateLimit const. The outcome names ride the column comment, the fate prose closes in its own round. The table tag T65Data identifier-safe per the R639 lesson
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 121 closed, 114 open - the Table 65 Fate box flips (census 590 -> 591); the shukenja chapter boxes are ALL CLOSED - NEXT - R669: the wu jen spell chapter opens, Table 66 Wu Jen Spells (capture p. 153, the full spell list by level), prefix did (verified free - dic is NOT free: the dice() helpers), audit "R669 OA wu jen spell list audit"

consts.comment: a character can only have one fate at a time - once determined, the nature of the event cannot be changed (print p. 135; compressed p. 66)

tables.name: didT65Grid
col_comments: the fate band face widths by ordinal (print p. 135; compressed p. 66). The band list rides this comment: 0 roll 1, 1 roll 2, 2 roll 3, 3 rolls 4-5, 4 rolls 6-7, 5 rolls 8-9, 6 rolls 10-12, 7 rolls 13-15, 8 rolls 16-17, 9 roll 18, 10 roll 19, 11 roll 20 - the widths sum to the twenty faces of the die: six single-face bands at the ladder ends (rolls 1, 2, 3, 18, 19, 20), four two-face bands (rolls 4-5, 6-7, 8-9, 16-17) and the two three-face widest bands at the ladder middle (rolls 10-12 and 13-15). The outcomes themselves are prose - the DM-adventure seeds riding the printed table, not pinned cells
